interpreter: bash --noprofile --norc; host macOS interpreter, command effects replaced by pure shell functions
scope: Only dependency sequencing and shell syntax. mkdir/cd/wget/read/sudo/tail are stubs. No real installation, network access, Host service, file write, key or account access. Input fixture-only-placeholder is synthetic.
summary: Ten disposable shell cases matched their explicit expectations. The original install fence still calls its Python installer after a stubbed download failure or empty key; the corrected fence skips it. The original port fence still restarts after a stubbed write failure; the corrected fence skips restart. Successful fixture prerequisites retain the intended calls. No real command side effects were allowed.
